title: Understanding the Importance of Massive Activations through Adversarial Robustness
abstract: arXiv:2611.32585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A common occurrence in Large Language Models (LLMs) is the emergence of so-called massive activations. This phenomenon is well known in the literature and has been connected to attention sinks, representational compression, as well as signal propagation. However, the reasons and consequences for their appearance are not yet well understood. In this paper, we explain the role of massive activations in deep learning by showing that they are connected to the region migration phenomenon in delayed robustness. Under the spline theoretic interpretation of deep networks, we show that massive activations push the representations away from the nonlinearity boundaries of the network, decreasing the complexity of its input-output map around data points. translated_title: 通过对抗鲁棒性理解大规模激活的重要性
translated_abstract: 在大型语言模型（LLMs）中，一个常见的现象是所谓的大规模激活（massive activations）的出现。这一现象在文献中广为人知，并与注意力汇聚、表示压缩以及信号传播相关联。然而，其出现的原因和后果尚未得到很好的理解。在本文中，我们通过证明大规模激活与延迟鲁棒性中的区域迁移现象相关联，解释了大规模激活在深度学习中的作用。在深度网络的样条理论解释下，我们表明大规模激活将表示推离网络的非线性边界，降低了数据点周围输入输出映射的复杂性。此外，我们首次发现这一现象并非Transformer所独有，实际上也出现在许多执行简单监督学习任务的常见架构中。
tldr: 本文将大规模激活与延迟鲁棒性中的区域迁移现象联系起来，证明大规模激活通过将表示推离网络非线性边界来降低输入输出映射的复杂性，并首次发现该现象并非Transformer独有，也普遍存在于其他常见架构中。
